title: Matthew Brown's view of humans as a resource for NHI
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Matthew Brown's view of humans as a resource for NHI, about 2020s at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: end of your interview, he says, you know, um people are resource maybe for the NHI

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls an interview that the UFO filmmaker Jeremy Corbell did with a man named Matthew Brown in the 2020s. Michels says that at the end of that interview Brown suggested that people might be a resource for NHI, short for non-human intelligence, which would mean humans are being used rather than simply watched.
